import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from datetime import datetime

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

csv_path = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

# Coerce types used downstream
for col in ['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score', 'Released_Year', 'No_of_Votes']:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
current_year = datetime.now().year
years_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Released_Year'], errors='coerce')
series_len_ok = df['Series_Title'].astype(str).str.len().between(1, 200)
years_int_ok = years_num.notna() & ((years_num % 1) == 0)
years_range_ok = years_num.between(1900, current_year)
year_digits_ok = years_num.dropna().astype(int).astype(str).str.fullmatch(r'\d{4}').all()
unique_key_ok = (not df.duplicated(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).any())
assert series_len_ok.all() and years_int_ok.all() and years_range_ok.all() and year_digits_ok and unique_key_ok
# ASSERTION_END

df['Released_Year'] = df['Released_Year'].astype(int)

df['title_key'] = df['Series_Title'].astype(str).str.strip() + '|' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str)

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['IMDB_Rating'].notna().all()
assert ((df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 0.0) & (df['IMDB_Rating'] <= 10.0)).all()
assert np.isclose(df['IMDB_Rating'], df['IMDB_Rating'].round(1)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Runtime parsing guards and distribution checks
# ASSERTION_START
rt_str = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
pat_ok = rt_str.str.fullmatch(r'\d{2,3} min')
mins = pd.to_numeric(rt_str.str.extract(r'(\d{2,3})')[0], errors='coerce')
range_ok = mins.notna() & mins.between(45, 240)
central_mass_ok = mins.between(80, 180).mean() >= 0.90
assert pat_ok.all() and range_ok.all() and central_mass_ok
# ASSERTION_END

df['Runtime_min'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Runtime'].astype(str).str.extract(r'(\d{2,3})')[0], errors='coerce')

# Votes checks before normalization
# ASSERTION_START
votes_ok = df['No_of_Votes'].notna() & ((df['No_of_Votes'] % 1) == 0) & (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 0)
min_votes_ok = (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 1000).all()
p70_ok = (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 10000).mean() >= 0.70
assert votes_ok.all() and min_votes_ok and p70_ok
# ASSERTION_END

# Meta score health and correlation with rating
both = df[['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
meta_presence_ratio = df['Meta_score'].notna().mean()
# ASSERTION_START
both_local = df[['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
meta_range_ok = both_local['Meta_score'].between(0, 100).all()
meta_presence_ok = df['Meta_score'].notna().mean() >= 0.80
std_ok = (both_local['IMDB_Rating'].std(ddof=0) > 0) and (both_local['Meta_score'].std(ddof=0) > 0)
corr_val = both_local['IMDB_Rating'].corr(both_local['Meta_score']) if len(both_local) > 1 else np.nan
corr_ok = (not np.isnan(corr_val)) and (corr_val >= 0.3)
assert meta_range_ok and meta_presence_ok and std_ok and corr_ok
# ASSERTION_END

# Genre and certificate constraints before building carousels
allowed_genres = {
    'Action','Adventure','Animation','Biography','Comedy','Crime','Drama','Family','Fantasy','History','Horror',
    'Mystery','Romance','Sci-Fi','Sport','Thriller','War','Western','Music','Musical','Film-Noir'
}
allowed_certs = {'U','UA','A','G','PG','PG-13','R','NC-17','Not Rated'}
# ASSERTION_START
split_genres = df['Genre'].astype(str).str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])
len_ok = split_genres.apply(len).between(1, 3).all()
subset_ok = split_genres.apply(lambda xs: set(xs).issubset(allowed_genres)).all()
cert_presence_ok = df['Certificate'].notna().mean() >= 0.85
cert_allowed_ok = df.loc[df['Certificate'].notna(), 'Certificate'].isin(allowed_certs).all()
family_anim_mask = split_genres.apply(lambda xs: ('Family' in xs) or ('Animation' in xs))
cert_not_adult_mask = ~df['Certificate'].isin({'A','R','NC-17'})
family_rule_ok = (cert_not_adult_mask | ~family_anim_mask).all()
assert len_ok and subset_ok and cert_presence_ok and cert_allowed_ok and family_rule_ok
# ASSERTION_END

# Gross parsing and checks before tie-break sort
# ASSERTION_START
non_null_gross_ratio = df['Gross'].notna().mean()
pat = df.loc[df['Gross'].notna(), 'Gross'].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r'^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*$').all()
assert non_null_gross_ratio >= 0.80 and pat
# ASSERTION_END

# Parse gross to integer
gross_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df['Gross'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((gross_numeric.dropna() >= 0).all())
# ASSERTION_END

df['Gross_val'] = gross_numeric.fillna(0).astype(float)

# Poster link validation and uniqueness before creating cards
# ASSERTION_START
def _is_valid_http_url(u):
    if pd.isna(u):
        return False
    p = urlparse(str(u))
    return p.scheme in ('http', 'https') and bool(p.netloc)
non_null_links = df['Poster_Link'].notna().all()
valid_urls = df['Poster_Link'].apply(_is_valid_http_url).all()
unique_ratio = df['Poster_Link'].nunique(dropna=True) / len(df)
assert non_null_links and valid_urls and unique_ratio >= 0.95
# ASSERTION_END

# Star cast constraints before composing cast display
# ASSERTION_START
stars_non_null = df[['Star1','Star2','Star3','Star4']].notna().all().all()
lengths_ok = (
    df['Star1'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all() and
    df['Star2'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all() and
    df['Star3'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all() and
    df['Star4'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all()
)
distinct_within_row = (df[['Star1','Star2','Star3','Star4']]
    .astype(str)
    .apply(lambda r: len({r['Star1'], r['Star2'], r['Star3'], r['Star4']}) == 4, axis=1)
    .all())
assert stars_non_null and lengths_ok and distinct_within_row
# ASSERTION_END

# Derivations for scoring
genre_tokens = df['Genre'].astype(str).str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])
df['Primary_Genre'] = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: xs[0])

# Genre boost mapping
genre_weight_map = {
    'Action': 1.06,
    'Adventure': 1.05,
    'Comedy': 1.03,
    'Drama': 1.00,
    'Sci-Fi': 1.08,
    'Thriller': 1.06,
    'Family': 1.04,
    'Animation': 1.04,
    'Horror': 0.98,
    'Mystery': 1.03,
    'Romance': 1.00,
    'Crime': 1.02,
    'Biography': 1.00,
    'History': 1.00,
    'Fantasy': 1.02,
    'Sport': 1.01,
    'War': 1.00,
    'Western': 1.00,
    'Music': 1.00,
    'Musical': 1.01,
    'Film-Noir': 1.02,
}

def genre_boost(tokens):
    ws = [genre_weight_map.get(t, 1.0) for t in tokens]
    return float(np.mean(ws)) if ws else 1.0

df['genre_boost'] = genre_tokens.apply(genre_boost)

# Popularity weight from votes
min_anchor = np.log1p(1000)
max_anchor = np.log1p(500000)
vote_scaled = (np.log1p(df['No_of_Votes']) - min_anchor) / (max_anchor - min_anchor)
df['pop_weight'] = vote_scaled.clip(0, 1)

# Runtime preference centered at 120 minutes
rt_dev = (df['Runtime_min'] - 120).abs()
df['runtime_score'] = (1 - (rt_dev / 60)).clip(0, 1)

# Normalize ratings and meta
rating_norm = df['IMDB_Rating'] / 10.0
meta_norm_raw = df['Meta_score'] / 100.0

# Correlation-informed weighting
corr_for_weight = both['IMDB_Rating'].corr(both['Meta_score']) if len(both) > 1 else 0.3
w_meta = float(np.clip(corr_for_weight, 0.3, 0.6))
w_rating = 1.0 - w_meta

# Impute missing meta using rating scaled by correlation
meta_norm = meta_norm_raw.where(meta_norm_raw.notna(), rating_norm * corr_for_weight)

base_score = (w_rating * rating_norm) + (w_meta * meta_norm)
adj_score = base_score * (0.7 + 0.3 * df['pop_weight']) * (0.8 + 0.2 * df['runtime_score']) * df['genre_boost']

df['score'] = adj_score

# Tie-break sort using gross and votes
sorted_df = df.sort_values(by=['score', 'Gross_val', 'No_of_Votes'], ascending=[False, False, False])

# Build cards with validated poster links and cast display
sorted_df['cast_display'] = (
    sorted_df['Star1'].astype(str) + ', ' +
    sorted_df['Star2'].astype(str) + ', ' +
    sorted_df['Star3'].astype(str) + ', ' +
    sorted_df['Star4'].astype(str)
)

cards_cols = [
    'title_key','Series_Title','Released_Year','Primary_Genre','Certificate','Runtime_min',
    'IMDB_Rating','Meta_score','No_of_Votes','Gross_val','Poster_Link','score','cast_display'
]

cards_df = sorted_df[cards_cols].copy()

# Overall Top Picks
overall_top = cards_df.head(50).copy()
overall_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(overall_top) + 1))
overall_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'overall_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Family/Animation carousel (guarded by earlier certificate rule)
family_mask = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: ('Family' in xs) or ('Animation' in xs))
family_top = cards_df[family_mask].head(30).copy()
family_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(family_top) + 1))
family_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'family_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Action & Adventure carousel
act_adv_mask = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: ('Action' in xs) or ('Adventure' in xs))
action_top = cards_df[act_adv_mask].head(30).copy()
action_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(action_top) + 1))
action_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'action_adventure_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Thriller & Mystery carousel
thr_mys_mask = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: ('Thriller' in xs) or ('Mystery' in xs))
thrill_top = cards_df[thr_mys_mask].head(30).copy()
thrill_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(thrill_top) + 1))
thrill_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'thriller_mystery_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Write simple metadata for audit
meta_out = {
    'rows': int(len(df)),
    'meta_presence_ratio': float(meta_presence_ratio),
    'corr_imdb_meta': float(corr_for_weight),
    'w_rating': float(w_rating),
    'w_meta': float(w_meta)
}
pd.Series(meta_out).to_json(os.path.join(args.output, 'scoring_meta.json'))

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from datetime import datetime

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

csv_path = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

# Coerce types used downstream
for col in ['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score', 'Released_Year', 'No_of_Votes']:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# ASSERTION_START
current_year = datetime.now().year
years_num = pd.to_numeric(df['Released_Year'], errors='coerce')
series_len_ok = df['Series_Title'].astype(str).str.len().between(1, 200)
years_int_ok = years_num.notna() & ((years_num % 1) == 0)
years_range_ok = years_num.between(1900, current_year)
year_digits_ok = years_num.dropna().astype(int).astype(str).str.fullmatch(r'\d{4}').all()
unique_key_ok = (not df.duplicated(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).any())
assert series_len_ok.all() and years_int_ok.all() and years_range_ok.all() and year_digits_ok and unique_key_ok
# ASSERTION_END

df['Released_Year'] = df['Released_Year'].astype(int)

df['title_key'] = df['Series_Title'].astype(str).str.strip() + '|' + df['Released_Year'].astype(str)

# ASSERTION_START
assert df['IMDB_Rating'].notna().all()
assert ((df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 0.0) & (df['IMDB_Rating'] <= 10.0)).all()
assert np.isclose(df['IMDB_Rating'], df['IMDB_Rating'].round(1)).all()
# ASSERTION_END

# Runtime parsing guards and distribution checks
# ASSERTION_START
rt_str = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
pat_ok = rt_str.str.fullmatch(r'\d{2,3} min')
mins = pd.to_numeric(rt_str.str.extract(r'(\d{2,3})')[0], errors='coerce')
range_ok = mins.notna() & mins.between(45, 240)
central_mass_ok = mins.between(80, 180).mean() >= 0.90
assert pat_ok.all() and range_ok.all() and central_mass_ok
# ASSERTION_END

df['Runtime_min'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Runtime'].astype(str).str.extract(r'(\d{2,3})')[0], errors='coerce')

# Votes checks before normalization
# ASSERTION_START
votes_ok = df['No_of_Votes'].notna() & ((df['No_of_Votes'] % 1) == 0) & (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 0)
min_votes_ok = (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 1000).all()
p70_ok = (df['No_of_Votes'] >= 10000).mean() >= 0.70
assert votes_ok.all() and min_votes_ok and p70_ok
# ASSERTION_END

# Meta score health and correlation with rating
both = df[['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
meta_presence_ratio = df['Meta_score'].notna().mean()
# ASSERTION_START
both_local = df[['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
meta_range_ok = both_local['Meta_score'].between(0, 100).all()
meta_presence_ok = df['Meta_score'].notna().mean() >= 0.80
std_ok = (both_local['IMDB_Rating'].std(ddof=0) > 0) and (both_local['Meta_score'].std(ddof=0) > 0)
corr_val = both_local['IMDB_Rating'].corr(both_local['Meta_score']) if len(both_local) > 1 else np.nan
corr_ok = (not np.isnan(corr_val)) and (corr_val >= 0.3)
assert meta_range_ok and meta_presence_ok and std_ok and corr_ok
# ASSERTION_END

# Genre and certificate constraints before building carousels
allowed_genres = {
    'Action','Adventure','Animation','Biography','Comedy','Crime','Drama','Family','Fantasy','History','Horror',
    'Mystery','Romance','Sci-Fi','Sport','Thriller','War','Western','Music','Musical','Film-Noir'
}
allowed_certs = {'U','UA','A','G','PG','PG-13','R','NC-17','Not Rated'}
# ASSERTION_START
split_genres = df['Genre'].astype(str).str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])
len_ok = split_genres.apply(len).between(1, 3).all()
subset_ok = split_genres.apply(lambda xs: set(xs).issubset(allowed_genres)).all()
cert_presence_ok = df['Certificate'].notna().mean() >= 0.85
cert_allowed_ok = df.loc[df['Certificate'].notna(), 'Certificate'].isin(allowed_certs).all()
family_anim_mask = split_genres.apply(lambda xs: ('Family' in xs) or ('Animation' in xs))
cert_not_adult_mask = ~df['Certificate'].isin({'A','R','NC-17'})
family_rule_ok = (cert_not_adult_mask | ~family_anim_mask).all()
assert len_ok and subset_ok and cert_presence_ok and cert_allowed_ok and family_rule_ok
# ASSERTION_END

# Gross parsing and checks before tie-break sort
# ASSERTION_START
non_null_gross_ratio = df['Gross'].notna().mean()
pat = df.loc[df['Gross'].notna(), 'Gross'].astype(str).str.fullmatch(r'^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*$').all()
assert non_null_gross_ratio >= 0.80 and pat
# ASSERTION_END

# Parse gross to integer
gross_numeric = pd.to_numeric(df['Gross'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
# ASSERTION_START
assert ((gross_numeric.dropna() >= 0).all())
# ASSERTION_END

df['Gross_val'] = gross_numeric.fillna(0).astype(float)

# Poster link validation and uniqueness before creating cards
# ASSERTION_START
def _is_valid_http_url(u):
    if pd.isna(u):
        return False
    p = urlparse(str(u))
    return p.scheme in ('http', 'https') and bool(p.netloc)
non_null_links = df['Poster_Link'].notna().all()
valid_urls = df['Poster_Link'].apply(_is_valid_http_url).all()
unique_ratio = df['Poster_Link'].nunique(dropna=True) / len(df)
assert non_null_links and valid_urls and unique_ratio >= 0.95
# ASSERTION_END

# Star cast constraints before composing cast display
# ASSERTION_START
stars_non_null = df[['Star1','Star2','Star3','Star4']].notna().all().all()
lengths_ok = (
    df['Star1'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all() and
    df['Star2'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all() and
    df['Star3'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all() and
    df['Star4'].astype(str).str.len().between(2,50).all()
)
distinct_within_row = (df[['Star1','Star2','Star3','Star4']]
    .astype(str)
    .apply(lambda r: len({r['Star1'], r['Star2'], r['Star3'], r['Star4']}) == 4, axis=1)
    .all())
assert stars_non_null and lengths_ok and distinct_within_row
# ASSERTION_END

# Derivations for scoring
genre_tokens = df['Genre'].astype(str).str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])
df['Primary_Genre'] = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: xs[0])

# Genre boost mapping
genre_weight_map = {
    'Action': 1.06,
    'Adventure': 1.05,
    'Comedy': 1.03,
    'Drama': 1.00,
    'Sci-Fi': 1.08,
    'Thriller': 1.06,
    'Family': 1.04,
    'Animation': 1.04,
    'Horror': 0.98,
    'Mystery': 1.03,
    'Romance': 1.00,
    'Crime': 1.02,
    'Biography': 1.00,
    'History': 1.00,
    'Fantasy': 1.02,
    'Sport': 1.01,
    'War': 1.00,
    'Western': 1.00,
    'Music': 1.00,
    'Musical': 1.01,
    'Film-Noir': 1.02,
}

def genre_boost(tokens):
    ws = [genre_weight_map.get(t, 1.0) for t in tokens]
    return float(np.mean(ws)) if ws else 1.0

df['genre_boost'] = genre_tokens.apply(genre_boost)

# Popularity weight from votes
min_anchor = np.log1p(1000)
max_anchor = np.log1p(500000)
vote_scaled = (np.log1p(df['No_of_Votes']) - min_anchor) / (max_anchor - min_anchor)
df['pop_weight'] = vote_scaled.clip(0, 1)

# Runtime preference centered at 120 minutes
rt_dev = (df['Runtime_min'] - 120).abs()
df['runtime_score'] = (1 - (rt_dev / 60)).clip(0, 1)

# Normalize ratings and meta
rating_norm = df['IMDB_Rating'] / 10.0
meta_norm_raw = df['Meta_score'] / 100.0

# Correlation-informed weighting
corr_for_weight = both['IMDB_Rating'].corr(both['Meta_score']) if len(both) > 1 else 0.3
w_meta = float(np.clip(corr_for_weight, 0.3, 0.6))
w_rating = 1.0 - w_meta

# Impute missing meta using rating scaled by correlation
meta_norm = meta_norm_raw.where(meta_norm_raw.notna(), rating_norm * corr_for_weight)

base_score = (w_rating * rating_norm) + (w_meta * meta_norm)
adj_score = base_score * (0.7 + 0.3 * df['pop_weight']) * (0.8 + 0.2 * df['runtime_score']) * df['genre_boost']

df['score'] = adj_score

# Tie-break sort using gross and votes
sorted_df = df.sort_values(by=['score', 'Gross_val', 'No_of_Votes'], ascending=[False, False, False])

# Build cards with validated poster links and cast display
sorted_df['cast_display'] = (
    sorted_df['Star1'].astype(str) + ', ' +
    sorted_df['Star2'].astype(str) + ', ' +
    sorted_df['Star3'].astype(str) + ', ' +
    sorted_df['Star4'].astype(str)
)

cards_cols = [
    'title_key','Series_Title','Released_Year','Primary_Genre','Certificate','Runtime_min',
    'IMDB_Rating','Meta_score','No_of_Votes','Gross_val','Poster_Link','score','cast_display'
]

cards_df = sorted_df[cards_cols].copy()

# Overall Top Picks
overall_top = cards_df.head(50).copy()
overall_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(overall_top) + 1))
overall_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'overall_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Family/Animation carousel (guarded by earlier certificate rule)
family_mask = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: ('Family' in xs) or ('Animation' in xs))
family_top = cards_df[family_mask].head(30).copy()
family_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(family_top) + 1))
family_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'family_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Action & Adventure carousel
act_adv_mask = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: ('Action' in xs) or ('Adventure' in xs))
action_top = cards_df[act_adv_mask].head(30).copy()
action_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(action_top) + 1))
action_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'action_adventure_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Thriller & Mystery carousel
thr_mys_mask = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: ('Thriller' in xs) or ('Mystery' in xs))
thrill_top = cards_df[thr_mys_mask].head(30).copy()
thrill_top.insert(0, 'rank', range(1, len(thrill_top) + 1))
thrill_top.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'thriller_mystery_top_picks.csv'), index=False)

# Write simple metadata for audit
meta_out = {
    'rows': int(len(df)),
    'meta_presence_ratio': float(meta_presence_ratio),
    'corr_imdb_meta': float(corr_for_weight),
    'w_rating': float(w_rating),
    'w_meta': float(w_meta)
}
pd.Series(meta_out).to_json(os.path.join(args.output, 'scoring_meta.json'))
